I need to find pet-friendly accommodations for 2 people in Dayton, Cincinnati, and Columbus from this CSV file: /app/data/accommodations/clean_accommodations_2022.csv

Pet-friendly means the house_rules field does NOT contain "No pets". The accommodation must have maximum_occupancy >= 2.

Please run these commands:

```bash
# Dayton pet-friendly for 2+ people
echo "=== DAYTON PET-FRIENDLY ==="
head -1 /app/data/accommodations/clean_accommodations_2022.csv
grep -i "Dayton" /app/data/accommodations/clean_accommodations_2022.csv | grep -iv "No pets"

echo ""
echo "=== CINCINNATI PET-FRIENDLY ==="
grep -i "Cincinnati" /app/data/accommodations/clean_accommodations_2022.csv | grep -iv "No pets"

echo ""
echo "=== COLUMBUS PET-FRIENDLY ==="  
grep -i "Columbus" /app/data/accommodations/clean_accommodations_2022.csv | grep -iv "No pets"
```

Return ALL results. I need to pick accommodations that are affordable (budget ~$5100 total for 7 days for 2 people) and accommodate 2+ people.
